entries.subject: Decentralized Creative Collaborative

entries.label: Immersive Narratives
entries.quote: As our entertainment devices become more advanced, consumers are increasingly seeking out more engaging content that they can experience with multiple senses.
entries.subject: Immersive Narratives

entries.label: Personalized Content
entries.quote: With the emergence of more flexible forms of storytelling, audiences are no longer limited to a single journey.
entries.subject: Personalized Content

entries.label: Massive Interactive Live Events
entries.quote: Combining the reach of broadcast TV and the interactivity of video games, massive interactive live events (MILEs) invite audiences to follow a plotline that unfolds over several weeks, encouraging them to interact with a livestream to impact the action.
entries.subject: Massive Interactive Live Events

entries.label: Digital Celebrities
entries.quote: Virtual stars never complain or get into trouble—plus, they work for free and are always available.
entries.subject: Digital Celebrities

entries.label: AI Assisted Creativity
entries.quote: Artists are increasingly relying on artificial intelligence not only to improve their creative processes and come up with project ideas but also to generate complete works—and even direct productions—with very little guidance.
entries.subject: AI Assisted Creativity

entries.label: AI Generated Voice Acting
entries.quote: AI makes it possible to take a film’s dialogue and dub it in multiple languages using re-creations of the actors’ voices.
entries.subject: AI Generated Voice Acting

entries.label: Automated Content Production
entries.quote: AI is providing more efficient ways to streamline workflows and processes, enabling companies to not only scale their corporate communications and marketing efforts but also crank out fresh material at lightning speed with just a few text prompts and clicks.
entries.subject: Automated Content Production

entries.label: Business Model Evolution
entries.quote: Streaming platforms are revamping their business models in an effort to decrease shrinking membership.
entries.subject: Business Model Evolution

entries.label: Environmental Impact of Streaming
entries.quote: Though media streaming might be more eco-friendly than producing a vinyl record or CD, it still accounts for 3%-4% of the global carbon footprint.
entries.subject: Environmental Impact of Streaming

entries.label: Blockchain Art Market
entries.quote: The blockchain art market— which centers on NFT-based works created using modeling, algorithms, and data—went bust in 2022, partly due to the rapid devaluation of crypto exacerbated by the fall of digital currency exchange FTX.
entries.subject: Blockchain Art Market

entries.label: Protecting Creativity
entries.quote: Slowly but surely, new regulations on intellectual property and copyrights surrounding AIgenerated content are trickling in around the globe—but not fast enough.
entries.subject: Protecting Creativity

entries.label: Multi-use Spaces
entries.quote: Since films are so readily available at home via streaming, audiences are demanding a lot more from in-theater experiences.
entries.subject: Multi-use Spaces

entries.label: Performances Embrace Technology
entries.quote: Creatives are playing with new ways to incorporate technology into their works to better engage viewers, showcase alternate realities, and connect audiences around the world.
entries.subject: Performances Embrace Technology

entries.label: The Holographic Live Performance
entries.quote: Volumetric capture and highspeed connectivity are enabling larger-than-life hologram shows, with digital 3D renderings of human and animal performers alike taking over every stage.
entries.subject: The Holographic Live Performance

entries.label: Virtual Reality Concerts
entries.quote: Virtual reality concerts— which feature digitized stars performing in the metaverse— have given entertainers a chance to rebound after countless live shows were canceled due to the pandemic.
entries.subject: Virtual Reality Concerts

entries.label: XR Fine Art
entries.quote: Armed with a growing stable of creative tools powered by new technologies, artists are increasingly blurring the lines between the physical and digital worlds.
entries.subject: XR Fine Art

entries.label: AI Generated Fine Art
entries.quote: AI-powered creative tools are making it possible to create elaborate works of art nearly instantaneously.
entries.subject: AI Generated Fine Art

entries.label: Climate Infiltrates Art and Performance
entries.quote: Artists and musicians are leveraging their craft to bring attention to environmental issues plaguing the planet, from global warming and deforestation to animal endangerment and reef preservation.
entries.subject: Climate Infiltrates Art and Performance

entries.label: VR in Location-Based Entertainment
entries.quote: Location-based entertainment (LBE) offers high-fidelity experiences that take place in a set physical space as opposed to exclusively online.
entries.subject: VR in Location-Based Entertainment

entries.label: AR in Location-Based Entertainment
entries.quote: Augmented reality provides a more affordable and accessible way to enhance experiences than VR, and the rapidly-evolving technology is positioned to become the cornerstone of LBE entertainment in the coming years.
entries.subject: AR in Location-Based Entertainment

entries.label: Blockchain Integrations
entries.quote: Web3 is poised to disrupt business strategies and operations in the entertainment industry, offering new ways to combat piracy and boost efficiency, security, and transparency through blockchain technology.
entries.subject: Blockchain Integrations

entries.label: Assistive Amusement Park Robots
entries.quote: Robots are no longer just sitting pretty at theme parks.
entries.subject: Assistive Amusement Park Robots

entries.label: Amusement Parks for Niche Interests
entries.quote: Amusement parks are constantly evolving to meet consumers’ increasingly diverse interests.
entries.subject: Amusement Parks for Niche Interests

entries.label: Intuitive Optimization
entries.quote: Theme parks are leveraging AI and the Internet of Things—coupled with data gleaned from in-park platforms, mobile apps, and wearables—to analyze customer behavior and create more customized experiences.
entries.subject: Intuitive Optimization

entries.label: Dynamic Operations
entries.quote: Theme parks are leveraging data to sway customers’ decisions regarding when they will visit and what they will do during their stay, employing tactics such as surge pricing and push notifications that keep visitors up to date on wait times.
entries.subject: Dynamic Operations

entries.label: Immersive Museum Experiences
entries.quote: As society becomes more tech savvy, visitors at traditional institutions—including museums, zoos, galleries, and aquariums— are expecting attractions to be increasingly smart and captivating.
entries.subject: Immersive Museum Experiences

entries.label: Theme Parks Go Green
entries.quote: In an effort to decrease their carbon footprint amid worsening climate change, amusement parks are incorporating more ecofriendly features—from renewable energy installations and electricpowered vehicles to water conservation systems and largescale recycling programs.
entries.subject: Theme Parks Go Green
